title: PSRR reduced C_eff x ESR characterization sweep manifest (Phase 1 of #314)
note: Separate from experiment.json on purpose: the 45-corner psrr-dc manifest and its records stay unchanged (Phase 3 of #314 decides whether the binding point becomes a leg there). This manifest is a SAMPLED grid: 3 corners x 3 C_eff x 3 ESR. It cannot prove the continuous-window or all-45-corner worst case. No threshold lives here; bounds stay in experiment.json / spec/target-spec.md.
corners_source: identical to experiment.json quick_subset (verified by sim/tests/test_psrr_cap_sweep.py)
esr_zero_topology: ESR 0 is NOT a small-resistance stand-in. Batch path: the request netlist gains a direct capacitor CDIR from VOUT to ground (0 F by default, same realisation as sim/load-transient #313); an ESR = 0 point sets CDIR = C_eff and opens the series branch (COUT = 0 F, RESR parked at resr_park_ohm carrying no current); ESR > 0 points set CDIR = 0 F. apply_cap_point instead removes RESR and grounds COUT. The nominal point is C_eff 1 uF / ESR 10 mOhm (DR-002 proposed nominal).
seeding: Batch path (sim/bin/psrr-cap-sweep-run.py): ONE klt sim request per corner whose deck walks every point as ordered analysis_steps. Each point/load sets ALL of COUT, RESR, CDIR and RLOAD with explicit alters before its own op and ac, and the testbench's .nodeset seed (#171/#179) applies to every operating-point solve (ngspice applies .nodeset to each op, including the one each ac performs); order independence is checked by re-running independence_check.point at the end of the deck. The per-process helper apply_cap_point (one ngspice process per point) remains for local single-point spot checks.
load_rload_source: 1ma = the testbench's own RLOAD 1.8k; 50ma = experiment.json's 'alter rload = 36'
ac_args_source: experiment.json deck: 'ac lin 3 1e3 1e5', index 0 = 1 kHz, index 2 = 100 kHz

independence_check.note: The nominal point is re-run as the LAST point of each corner's deck; its values must equal the first run's (no state carried between points).

selection_rule: Per sub-metric: a point's value is the minimum over the 3 corners; the worst sampled point is the minimum of that over points; ties (|delta| <= 1e-6 dB) go to the lower C_eff, then the lower ESR. Any missing or non-finite cell for the metric yields NO finding (reported, never dropped).
